pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark regions exhibit sub-rhomboidal and polygonal geometry. Due to sensor blur, edge transitions show smooth pixel gradients rather than sharp angularity. Relative spatial area of patches is high compared to inter-patch spacing.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Lighter-toned pathways form a continuous topological graph across the flank. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform but lacks sharp definition due to image resolution.
